name: Lingonberry
siboNotes: Well-tolerated in SIBO diets due to low sugar content and absence of problematic FODMAPs. The tart flavor may help stimulate digestion.
preparationTips: Fresh lingonberries can be quite tart - consider mixing with low-FODMAP sweeteners
Frozen lingonberries work well in baking and maintain their nutritional value
Check commercial lingonberry products for added high-FODMAP ingredients like apple juice
Pairs excellently with savory dishes as a traditional Scandinavian accompaniment
